appDesc.message: Detects videos on web pages and saves them. Direct files, HLS and DASH. No tracking, no companion app, DRM is not bypassed.

noMediaText.message: Play the video on the page - streams are detected while they load.

parseError.message: Could not read the stream manifest

optSaveAs.message: Ask where to save each file

ytNone.message: YouTube returned no download links. Use “Record while playing”.

ytUnavailable.message: YouTube did not provide this video (login, age or region restriction).

ytCcBlocked.message: Blocked: only Creative Commons videos are allowed (see the settings).

ytDiagCopied.message: Copied. It contains no links, titles or IDs.

optYtCcOnly.message: YouTube: allow only Creative Commons videos

ytDirectBlocked.message: YouTube refuses this link for the extension (HTTP 403). Use “Record while playing” instead.

ytRecordHint.message: Reloads the page and plays the video muted at higher speed. Keep this tab open until it finishes.

ytRecErrDrm.message: The video is encrypted (DRM) and cannot be recorded.

ytRecErrTooLarge.message: The recording exceeded the size limit from settings.

optYtApi.message: YouTube: fetch links like the mobile app (main way)

optYtClientsHint.message: IOS, IOS_VDL, VISIONOS, ANDROID_VR. The first client whose URLs open fully wins; otherwise the one serving the most is used.

optYtOverridesHint.message: Change a client version/User-Agent or add your own: {"MYCLIENT":{"id":9,"version":"1.0","ua":"…","clientName":"X"}}. No extension update needed.

ytLimited.message: YouTube serves only the start of this file to this client. Pick a smaller variant or use “Record while playing”.

ytLimitedNote.message: YouTube serves the file only up to ~{mb} MB (no token). Larger variants are marked; use recording for them.

ytTestRunning.message: Testing… up to a few minutes, keep this tab open.

ytTestNone.message: No YouTube links to test yet.

optYtSequential.message: YouTube: download one piece at a time

optYtCpn.message: YouTube: add cpn to download links

ytRecInterrupted.message: Recording stopped early: the player switched to another video or an ad. What was captured so far can be saved.

mp3Missing.message: MP3 encoder (vendor/lame.js) is not installed. Download M4A/WEBM instead.

mp3Decode.message: The browser could not decode this audio. Download M4A/WEBM instead.

mp3TooLong.message: Audio is too long for in-browser MP3 conversion (limit 30 min). Download M4A/WEBM instead.

ytPageDone.message: Done: quality list updated. Pick a quality and download.

ytPageNone.message: Method 2 returned no links. Press "Copy YouTube diagnostics" and send it.

bugNotifStart.message: Download test is running. Do not close the tab, it takes up to a few minutes.

bugNotifError.message: Could not prepare the diagnostics. Please try again.

bugRunningText.message: Please do not close this tab or switch videos. It takes up to a few minutes; the diagnostics file is then saved automatically.

bugDoneText.message: The file was saved to your downloads folder:

bugPrivacy.message: The file contains no video links, cookies or visitor identifiers - only technical details about formats and server answers.

bugSendIntro.message: Send the file to the developer and include the text below (fill in the two empty lines):

bugAttachHint.message: Attach the diagnostics file to the issue or e-mail manually (drag it into the window).

optDiagFullUrls.message: Diagnostics: include full links (by default host and path only, no query values)

mergeFailedTwoFiles.message: Could not join video and audio into one file: two files were saved (video and .audio).

liveNote.message: Live stream: recording starts now and runs until you press Stop or the stream ends.

busyHint.message: Possible cause: too much download activity from your account or network. Wait a while (from several minutes to an hour) or clear this site's cookies, then reload the page.

ytLiveNote.message: Live stream (beta): it is recorded from the player in real time.

ytLiveHint.message: Recording starts right away, without reloading the page. Keep this tab open and the player running until you press Stop.

ytLiveFinishing.message: Finishing: waiting until audio and video line up (up to 25 s)…

hintYtSequential.message: YouTube throttles or cuts off parallel requests. The file is downloaded one piece after another, a few MB each, the way the player itself does it. Slower, but more reliable. Turn it off only for testing.

hintYtCpn.message: cpn is the playback session ID that the player itself sends with its requests. Without it some links answer with a 403 error. The extension adds it to the download links.

hintYtHeaders.message: The Origin, Referer and DNT headers are added to download requests, like a normal request from a YouTube page. It helps when the server rejects requests without them. No account data is sent.

hintYtApi.message: The extension asks YouTube for the video data the way the mobile app does (the clients listed below). This usually gives direct links to all formats. If turned off, only the data already on the page is used, which is often not enough.

helpLead.message: An extension that finds video and audio on the open page and saves them to your computer. It works locally: no external servers, no telemetry, no third-party programs to install.

helpS1a.message: Open a page with a video and start playback (on some sites the stream only appears after playback starts).

helpS1b.message: Click the VDL icon on the toolbar. The videos found are listed.

helpS1c.message: Choose the type and quality and press “Download”. Audio has its own row: MP3, M4A or WEBM.

helpS1d.message: Finished files appear in “History” (clock icon) and in the downloads folder (folder icon).

helpS1q.message: Shortcuts: the keyboard shortcuts (set them in Settings → General).

helpF2.message: **HLS (m3u8) and DASH (mpd):** quality choice, separate audio track, AES-128 encryption, video and audio joined into one file without re-encoding.

helpF3.message: **YouTube:** choice of type (MP4, WEBM, AV1) and resolution, audio download (MP3, M4A, WEBM), video and audio joined into one file. If a direct link is unavailable, there is a fallback: recording from the player.

helpF4.message: **YouTube live streams (beta):** recording from the player in real time without reloading the page. “Stop” ends the recording and joins video and audio into an .mp4 file. Audio cannot be downloaded separately.

helpF5.message: **Other sites:** Vimeo, Dailymotion, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), Twitch, TikTok, Bilibili, Canva, OK.ru, VK; other sites through general stream detection. On some sites the result is limited by what the page provides.

helpF6.message: **Live streams on other sites (HLS):** recording with the “Record” button, stopped manually or by the time limit.

helpP1.message: **Default preferences:** video quality and type, audio format and quality.

helpP2.message: **General:** notifications, history, “Save as”, file name template ({title} {site} {quality} {date} {time}), minimum file size, number of parallel segment downloads, live recording limit.

helpP3.message: **YouTube settings:** one piece at a time, adding cpn, Origin/Referer/DNT headers, links like the mobile app, link method, client order and overrides, “Creative Commons only” (on by default), and the Beta option “Recording from the player”. Click “?” next to an option for an explanation.

helpT1.message: Allow the extension to access all sites: `about:addons` → VDL → “Permissions”.

helpT2.message: If there are no links, use recording from the player.

helpT3.message: Press 🐞: the extension creates a diagnostics file and a ready-made report text. The file has no video links, cookies or visitor identifiers. Attach the file to an e-mail or a GitHub issue.

helpL1.message: DRM-protected streams (Widevine, FairPlay, etc.) are not downloaded and DRM is not circumvented.

helpL2.message: YouTube: encrypted formats and SABR streams are not supported. Tokens and signatures are not forged.

helpL3.message: Download only what you are allowed to save. You are responsible for following each site’s rules.

helpL4.message: Not supported: format conversion, batch downloads, playlists, subtitles.

helpV1.message: The extension sends nothing to the developer. Data (history, settings) is stored in your browser. Diagnostics are created only when you press the button and are sent only by you.

helpC1.message: **Third-party library.** **lamejs** 1.2.1, a JavaScript port of the LAME encoder, is used to convert audio to MP3.

helpC2.message: The file `vendor/lame.js` is built from the unmodified lamejs sources (`scripts/build-lamejs.mjs` rebuilds it) and can be replaced by another build that provides `lamejs.Mp3Encoder`. SHA-256: `f7f74b09d1190d9935e776169dd76c7b66e30db7e2f51b816af88f85a44ed9a8`.

helpC3.message: The library runs locally in the browser and makes no network requests. Without it MP3 is unavailable; other formats still work.

helpC4.message: Video handling (parsing streams and joining video with audio without re-encoding) uses VDL’s own muxer, `lib/mux.js`.

helpC5.message: This project contains code, or parts of it, generated by AI. Texts, comments and localizations are AI-generated.

consentIntro.message: VDL is only a tool. It is provided “as is” (AS IS), without any warranty.

consentRights.message: You agree to download only content you have the right to download, in accordance with the law.

consentLiability.message: All responsibility and all legal costs related to the use of VDL rest with you. The author of the extension bears no liability.

consentNeeded.message: Accept the terms of use in the VDL window first, then try again.

consentLocalOnly.message: This consent is not transferred and is stored locally.

optYtRecordUi.message: Show the option to record from the player

ytRecordDisabledHint.message: Could not get download links. You can turn on recording from the player in the settings.

optResetText.message: Restore all options to their default values. The download history and the accepted terms are not affected.

hintTemplate.message: How saved files are named. Tokens: {title} {site} {quality} {date} {time}. Example: {title} ({quality}) gives My video (720p).mp4. The extension is added automatically. The template must contain {title}; an empty field goes back to {title} {site} {date}.

hintMinSize.message: Direct files smaller than this are not listed (tiny images, pixels, tracking files). It does not affect HLS, DASH or YouTube. Enter 0 to show everything.

hintConcurrency.message: How many parts (segments) of an HLS or DASH stream are downloaded at the same time. A higher number is faster but loads the site and your connection more; lower it if a site returns errors. Also used when recording live streams.

hintLiveMax.message: A live recording stops by itself after this time and the file is saved. It applies to Twitch, other HLS live streams and recording from the YouTube player.

hintMaxStream.message: Upper limit for one HLS/DASH download or recording. The data is kept in memory until it is saved, so the limit protects the browser: the download or recording stops at this size. Raise it only if you have enough memory.

hintYtRecordUi.message: Shows the Record from the player button for ordinary YouTube videos, as a last resort when direct links are unavailable. Live streams and recordings already running are not affected. Off by default.

hintYtRecordSpeed.message: Playback speed while an ordinary video is recorded from the player. The recording takes the length of the video divided by this speed; a high speed may drop frames on a weak computer. Live streams are always recorded at 1x.

hintDefaultAudioFormat.message: The format pre-selected for saving audio only: MP3 plays everywhere (converted in the browser); M4A (AAC) and WEBM (Opus) keep the original sound without conversion.

hintNotifications.message: Shows a system notification when a download or recording finishes or fails.

hintHistory.message: Keeps a local list of finished downloads (title, site, date) on this computer, shown on the History page. Turn it off to stop adding new entries.

hintSaveAs.message: Opens the browser's Save As dialog for each download so you choose the folder and the name. When off, files go straight to the downloads folder.

hintYtMethod.message: Where the YouTube link request is made from. Auto tries the page first and the background as a reserve. Change it only to find the cause of a problem.

hintYtCcOnly.message: On by default. Downloading is allowed only for videos that YouTube marks with the Creative Commons license; for other videos a notice is shown. Turn it off only if you own the video or have the right to download it.

hintDiagFullUrls.message: In the diagnostics file links are shortened to host and path. Turn this on only if the developer asks: full links may contain identifiers from the address. The file is never sent automatically.

ccNoticeText.message: You are trying to download a video that is not under a Creative Commons license. By default VDL allows only Creative Commons videos. If you own this video or otherwise have the right to download it, turn this restriction off. By turning it off you confirm that you have the right to download the videos you save. This message is shown only once.

consentCc.message: If you turn off the “Creative Commons only” restriction for YouTube, you confirm that you have the right to download the videos you save.

legalNotice1.message: Use the extension only for content you are allowed to save.

legalNotice2.message: Compliance with the law is your responsibility.

ytRecordEnable.message: Turn on recording from the player

ytRecErrStart.message: The video could not be recorded from the very beginning. Try again.

helpLame.message: **LAME acknowledgment.** MP3 conversion uses the LAME encoder (through lamejs, LGPL-3.0). Thanks to the LAME project:

optDebugLog.message: Debug log: record everything the extension does (for troubleshooting)

hintDebugLog.message: Writes a text log of what VDL does: found streams, downloads, errors, YouTube requests, recording status. It is kept in this browser (last 1500 lines, about 250 KB) and never sent automatically. Links are shortened to host and path (full links only if the option above is on); no titles, no cookies. It starts after you click Save. Turn it off and press Clear when you no longer need it.

logAttachHint.message: Save the log to a file and attach it to the GitHub issue or e-mail (the link carries only the last lines).

helpT4.message: Hard to reproduce? Turn on the “Debug log” in the options (Diagnostics), repeat the problem, then view, copy, save or send the log there. The auto-diagnostics result is added to it. The log stays in your browser and is never sent by itself.

cmdAudio.message: Download the audio of the first detected media

hintHotkeys.message: Turns the shortcuts below on or off. Click a field and press the keys you want; Backspace clears it. A shortcut needs Ctrl, Alt or Command (Shift is optional) and a letter, digit, arrow or F key.

hkDownloadAudio.message: Download the audio of the first media

hkInvalid.message: This combination cannot be used as a shortcut.

hkChromeHint.message: This browser lets you change extension shortcuts only on its own page. Open the address:

noAudioHere.message: No audio to download on this page

ccBadgeTitle.message: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY): reuse is allowed with credit to the author. Check the license in the video description.

ytWhyAge.message: Age-restricted video (18+): YouTube gives it only to a signed-in account with a confirmed age, and VDL does not use your account. Try recording while playing.

ytWhyBot.message: YouTube asks to confirm you are not a robot: there were many requests from your network. Wait a few minutes to an hour or reload the page.

ytWhyPrivate.message: Private video: the author shared it only with selected people.

ytWhyRemoved.message: The video was removed or is not available on YouTube.

ytWhyRegion.message: The author has not made this video available in your country.

ytWhyMembers.message: Members-only video: it is open only to the channel's paying members. If you have access, try recording while playing.

ytWhyPaid.message: Paid video or film with copy protection (DRM): it cannot be downloaded or recorded.

ytWhyUpcoming.message: The stream or premiere has not started yet.

ytWhyUpcomingAt.message: The stream or premiere has not started yet. Start: {time}.

ytWhyContentCheck.message: YouTube asks you to confirm that you want to watch this video. Confirm it on the page and reload the page.

ytWhySabr.message: YouTube gave no direct links to this video. Use recording while playing.

ytWhyCut.message: YouTube cuts the download of this video off after the first part. Use recording while playing.

ytWhyRate.message: Too many requests to YouTube from your network. Wait a few minutes to an hour.

ytWhyNetwork.message: No connection to YouTube. Check the internet connection and reload the page.

ytWhyUnknown.message: YouTube did not give this video; the reason was not recognised.

ytWhyUnknownReason.message: YouTube did not give this video; the reason was not recognised. YouTube says: “{reason}”.

subsSaveTitle.message: Save the subtitles as an .srt file

subsWithVideoTitle.message: When you download the video, save these subtitles too: inside a .webm or .mkv file (switch them on in the player), otherwise as an .srt file with the same name next to the video

subsFailed.message: Could not get the subtitles. Turn them on in the player for a few seconds and try again.

optJoinFormat.message: Joining video and audio of different formats

joinMp4.message: MP4 (recommended: Telegram sends it as a video)

hintJoinFormat.message: When the video and the sound come in different formats (AV1 or H.264 with Opus, VP9 with AAC), they are joined without re-encoding. MP4 plays in browsers and players and Telegram sends it as a video; an .mkv goes to Telegram as a document.

hintSubs.message: Shows the Subtitles row in the card of a YouTube video. Off: the row is hidden and no subtitles are looked up or saved.

hintSubsWithVideo.message: The same as the "+ with video" tick in the card. On: downloading a video (also with a keyboard shortcut) saves the chosen subtitles too — inside a .webm or .mkv file, otherwise as an .srt file next to the video. Off: only the video.

hintSubsSrt.message: Shows the SRT button in the Subtitles row: it saves only the chosen subtitles as an .srt file, without the video.

androidSaveOnPage.message: The file is ready: go back to the video page — Firefox will offer to save it there.

hintTsFormat.message: TS streams (H.264 + AAC) are saved without re-encoding: MP4 opens in any player and on phones; MKV copes better with gaps in a recording and plays in VLC, mpv and desktop players; TS is saved as it came. The format can also be picked in the video card. With other codecs or above about 700 MB the TS file is saved. WEBM is not possible for TS without re-encoding.

hintGifMake.message: Short videos (up to 60 s) get a GIF format in the card: the site's original GIF when there is one, and a GIF made from the video right in the browser (480 or 320 pixels wide, 10 frames per second, no sound). A GIF is many times larger than the video and takes time to make.

gifTooLong.message: The video is longer than 60 seconds: no GIF is made from it.

gifDecode.message: The video could not be read to make a GIF.

updateHow.message: Unpack the archive into the extension's folder over the old files and press "Reload" on the extensions page.

optUpdateCheck.message: Notify about new versions (GitHub check once a day)

hintUpdateCheck.message: Once a day the extension looks at the latest release on GitHub (an ordinary request to api.github.com; nothing about you is sent) and shows a line in the popup when a new version is out. It installs nothing by itself. Only in the "updater" package for Chrome and Edge.

updateBuildNote.message: This is the "updater" package for Chrome and Edge: once a day it checks GitHub for a new version by itself and shows a notice in the extension's popup. The tick above turns the check and the notices off. The regular package and the Firefox version do not check for updates.
